exam_scheme.note: Combined Civil Services Examination-IV is conducted as a single-stage objective OMR examination. Unlike other examinations where language tests are merely qualifying, Group-IV combines Part A (Tamil Eligibility-cum-Scoring Test) and Part B (General Studies & Aptitude) to determine the candidate's total ranking mark out of 300.

stages.stage_name: Written Examination (Single Paper, Objective Type - OMR Method)
stages.source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 01/2024, Section 4: Scheme of Examination (Single Paper, SSLC Standard)

papers.paper_name: Part A — Tamil Eligibility-cum-Scoring Test (SSLC Standard, 100 Qs)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (60 marks) required for evaluation of Part B; marks added for ranking

papers.paper_name: Part B — General Studies (75 Qs) & Aptitude and Mental Ability Test (25 Qs, SSLC Standard)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined minimum qualifying mark for selection (Part A + Part B) is 90 marks (all communities)

financial_package.note: Salaries for Junior Assistants, VAOs, Typists, and Bill Collectors are based on Level 8 of the Tamil Nadu Revised Pay Matrix (₹19,500 - ₹71,900 under G.O. Ms. No. 303, Finance (Pay Cell) Department, dated 11.10.2017). Forest Guards and Watchers are mapped to Levels 7 and 5 respectively.
financial_package.pay_source_label: TNPSC Notification No. 01/2024, Section 3: Posts and Vacancies (Scale of pay Rs. 19,500 - 71,900, Level 8 under TN Pay Matrix)
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimate assumes Level 8 entry basic pay ₹19,500 with 58% DA plus Tamil Nadu Grade-classified HRA (₹1,500 - ₹3,000) and City Compensatory Allowance. Net pay accounts for Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS/NPS 10% of Basic+DA), NHIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Medical insurance coverage under the New Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) for state employees and eligible family members
Fixed travelling allowance / cycle allowance for village-level revenue inspections (VAO)
Quarters / house rent allowance based on posting station grade
Earned leave surrender and encashment benefits as per Tamil Nadu Leave Rules
Festival advance and special Pongal bonus as declared annually by the State Government

competition_benchmarks.note: TNPSC Group-IV is India's largest state recruitment exam by applicant volume, regularly surpassing 20 lakh registered candidates. Initial vacancies notified in advertisements are routinely enhanced through supplementary requisitions before counselling.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 326 (calculated: applicants ÷ initial notified vacancies)

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 299 (calculated: applicants ÷ initial notified vacancies)
